title: Square with a My Block
summary: The same square, using your own block called Side.
what: Exactly the same square as before, but the driving and turning live inside a My Block called Side.
why: My Blocks let you give a name to a group of blocks and reuse it. The main program reads like a sentence, and if you improve Side, every use of it gets better at once. Good teams build a toolbox of My Blocks.
try: Make a rectangle: use Side 40, Side 20, Side 40, Side 20 without the repeat.
Add a second input to Side for the turn amount.
